items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I come out, and the first job I had was with Dinah Washington... Then after my accident that Dinah Washington, she looked out for me... She sent all this to me.

ctx.x: Lamar Wright, Jr., first. I come out, and the first job I had was with Dinah Washington in New York on a package show, and then we went to Newark, New Jersey,
with the package show and added to it with James Moody, Dinah Washington and Arnett Cobb. We had two bands.
